description: Structured history and numbers for one ASX company: capital raises, substantial holders, board changes, director trades, M&A, quarterly cash and runway, and guidance/trading updates. kind selects the category: raises | holders | directors | director_trading | ma | cash | updates. Rows carry dates, amounts, prices, percentages and parties, each with its doc_key. The response carries dataAsOf (and, for cash, possiblyStale), which give the age of the figures. Free.

includeLending.description: holders only: include stock-lending notices (default false; they move a relevant interest without anyone building a stake).
